articles.title: Kalshi off-limits in multiple states as prediction markets, CFTC team up for battle
articles.snippet: Washington state is cut off for Kalshi customers while the company combats the development in court and its federal regulator keeps pursuing new rules.

articles.title: Coldcard strengthens seed generation with firmware update
articles.snippet: Coinkite urged Coldcard users to generate new seed phrases, warning that existing vulnerable seeds remain unsafe despite the security upgrade.

articles.title: South Korean lawmakers seek expanded FIU powers over unregistered crypto firms
articles.snippet: The proposal would let the FIU investigate suspected violations and refer unregistered crypto operators directly to law enforcement.

articles.title: US debt tops $40T stoking debate on what it means for Bitcoin
articles.snippet: Analysts say the $40 trillion debt milestone could bolster Bitcoin’s long-term case, even as Treasury yields, dollar strength and liquidity remain key near-term drivers.

articles.title: Wall Street and Washington Fuel Bitcoin Rally: Here's What's Going On
articles.snippet: Institutional buying, improving macro conditions and a friendlier regulatory outlook are supporting Bitcoin's rally, while billions in short liquidations have accelerated the move.
